description:

If you're the modelmakers at @LAIKAStudios working on #Wildwood, you do .... this. (Note: The Tested crew had to drag #AdamSavage out of this model #shop. Otherwise he’d STILL BE THERE.)

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Cosplayers Autumn Desjardins and Canora Anderson visit the shop to show Adam their award-winning cosplay that recently won second place at the World Cosplay Summit Championships! Autumn and Canora designed these light-up costumes and props based on the Tokyo Aliens manga series, and explain how they choreographed an elaborate two and a half minute stage performance for their entry. 

Autumn's Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/autumnscosplay/
Canora's Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cnr_cosplay/
